hero.title:
From documents to data,
from idea to working software.
hero.lead: I build OCR tools that end manual data entry from receipts, invoices and scanned PDFs, plus the web applications and automations that run a small business's daily work. Every delivery comes measured and documented.

items.title: Documents → Excel (OCR)
items.text: Tools that extract company, date, VAT, totals or table data from receipts, invoices and scanned PDFs into Excel/JSON. They run on your own computer or server; documents never go to the cloud. Values are cross-checked, and anything uncertain is flagged.

items.title: Web applications
items.text: Stock and order panels, admin dashboards, price calculators and ordering sites. Role-based access, reports, mobile-friendly UI; deployed on Vercel, Render or Cloudflare.

items.title: Automation & APIs
items.text: Handing repetitive work over to scripts: data collection, report and Excel generation. Deploying your tools to your server as an API: HTTPS, API keys, hardening, load testing and documentation.

items.title: Receipt OCR
items.alt: Fields read from a grocery receipt and the resulting JSON
items.problem: Company name, tax ID, date, VAT and totals of hundreds of receipts were typed in by hand for bookkeeping.
items.solution: CPU-only OCR with rule-based field extraction, no cloud or AI services. Rotated and side-by-side receipts are split automatically; VAT and totals are verified against each other. Then deployed to the client's server as an HTTPS API and measured with a load test.
items.result: Drop photos into a folder, get JSON out. A receipt whose amounts don't add up is never written silently; it is flagged for review.
items.note: Source code delivered to the client; contact me for a demo.

items.title: Cari Takip: Receivables & Installment Tracker
items.alt: Cari Takip customer detail screen: installment table, take-payment and WhatsApp reminder buttons
items.problem: Small businesses that sell on credit or in installments keep receivables in a ledger or in Excel, which makes overdue payments hard to spot and chase.
items.solution: A desktop program that works offline: the installment plan is previewed before saving, partial payments are recorded, and a ready-made WhatsApp reminder opens for overdue customers. Amounts are stored as integer kuruş; the rounding remainder goes to the last installment and due dates follow month ends (31 Jan, 28 Feb, 31 Mar).
items.result: Runs as a single .exe and the data stays on the user's computer. The business rules are separate from the UI and verified by 49 automated tests.
items.note: A sample project with no real customer data. Get in touch to discuss a version adapted to your business.

items.title: Scanned PDF → Excel
items.alt: A scanned materials list and the Excel table produced from it
items.problem: Tables in scanned PDFs can't be copied, and Turkish number format (1.250,50) stays as text in most converters, so Excel can't sum it.
items.solution: Pages with a text layer are read directly, scanned pages with OCR; columns are found from whitespace corridors on the page. Web (drag and drop) and desktop interfaces share one core.
items.result: The sample document was converted in 1.2 seconds; numbers are written as real numbers, so formulas work immediately.
items.note: Source code is private; contact me to try it with your own document.

items.title: INTSHOP: Stock & Order Panel
items.alt: INTSHOP store page: product cards with the best dealer prices
items.problem: Admins, dealers and customers needed to work on the same product catalog with different permissions.
items.solution: A three-role application: the admin manages the catalog and price-change requests, dealers set their own stock and prices, customers shop in the store. Stock movements, login logs and charted reports.
items.result: Live application: frontend on Vercel, API and database on Render. Runs locally with a single Docker Compose command.

items.title: SQL Mastery
items.alt: SQL Mastery lesson page: lesson list and progress bar
items.problem: Beginners lacked a step-by-step SQL resource that needs no installation.
items.solution: A single-page app that opens in the browser: 13 lessons, syntax-highlighted examples, table schemas and progress tracking stored in the browser. No library dependencies.
items.result: 50+ examples, from CREATE TABLE to window functions and stored procedures.

about.title: About
paragraphs: I'm a final-year engineering student. My coursework focuses on signal processing, embedded systems (STM32) and machine learning; I'm currently working on my graduation thesis.

As a freelancer I hand the repetitive, manual work of small businesses and bookkeeping processes over to software. With every delivery I measure and report how well things work, and I state a tool's limits openly.
